name: MyCoreRpidToLoinc
title: MY Core RSNA Playbook RPID to LOINC
publisher: Data Team, Digital Health Division, Ministry of Health Malaysia
description: Translates RSNA Radiology Playbook RPID identifiers to their LOINC equivalents, so that systems holding Playbook identifiers can reach the LOINC codes MY Core binds to. 1,012 RPIDs are covered; LOINC is the complete key and carries all 5,954 procedures.
